# Alu Studio

> Indie app studio building small, focused iOS/Android apps.

## Apps

- [Home](https://alu-studio.com/home/): Alu Studio is an indie app studio behind Pikgeon (postcard tracker), Babbby (baby activity ideas), Sotto (people notes) and DingPOS (offline-first iPad POS).
- [Pikgeon](https://alu-studio.com/pikgeon/): Keep your postcard memories organized. Smart OCR tracks your mailing journey, fully processed on-device for privacy.
- [Babbby](https://alu-studio.com/babbby/): Daily activity ideas for ages 0–6, matched to your child's age and to what you have at home. 342 activities, no ads, no subscription.
- [Sotto](https://alu-studio.com/sotto/): Remember the details that matter. Keep track of the little things about the people you care about.
- [DingPOS](https://alu-studio.com/dingpos/): Open your store in 10 minutes. An offline-first point of sale for iPad. Your data, your control.
